svg.title: Storage accounting cabinet:field labels determine what sentinel tickets mean
svg.desc: Original sixty-solid sorting cabinet metaphor;identical zero tickets have different meanings in content-offset,freeblock and cell-count drawers.Static Figure tier,not physical SQLite storage.

g.text: FIG143 · FIELD CONTEXT BEFORE BYTE ACCOUNTING
A zero content offset can describe an entirely empty64KiB page
File page-size1 and content-offset0 both represent65536—in different fields
Decode the sentinel before subtracting headers;do not clamp negative evidence
Original header geometry and benign raw-page fixture · dbstat unavailable stays null;no native patch or full-file validation
